metadata.title: Validate Process Steps Exist
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Validation report of existing vs. missing process-steps

output.description: Validation report of existing vs. missing process-steps

prerequisites: Template contains stepRef references in its steps array
specificActions: Follow the substeps below in sequence
Workflow: read template -> extract stepRef UUIDs -> scan for matching id fields -> create report -> handle missing
Each stepRef is a UUID that must match the id field of a step definition JSON file in a subdirectory of the template directory
Framework steps are identified by type: framework-step in their JSON and are resolved from ~/.claude/agentic-processes/framework-steps/ by scanning for matching id field
If missing steps found: report them and STOP -- user must create the step definition with a matching id field

read: Step definition JSON files in template subdirectories (scan for matching id field)

tools: read_file - Read template and check step files
list_dir - Verify step subdirectories exist within template directory
bestPractices: Extract all stepRef UUID values from the template steps array
For each stepRef UUID, scan template subdirectories for a step definition JSON file whose id field matches the UUID
Also scan ~/.claude/agentic-processes/framework-steps/ for framework step definitions with matching id field
No prefix handling needed -- all stepRefs are plain UUIDs; framework steps are identified by their type: framework-step field
Document all missing steps with their UUID and the stepRefName companion field (if available) for readability
Provide clear report of validation results

substeps.name: Read template file
substeps.description: Load the template content for analysis
actions: Read the template JSON file
Document template being validated
Identify the template directory path

substeps.name: Extract step references
substeps.description: Find all stepRef UUID values in the template steps array
actions: Parse the steps array from the template JSON
For each step, extract the stepRef UUID value (skip null stepRefs for orchestrator steps)
Note the stepRefName companion field for each step (human-readable display name)
Create list of all referenced step UUIDs

substeps.name: Check step existence
substeps.description: Verify each referenced step UUID resolves to an existing step definition
actions: Build a UUID-to-path registry by scanning all subdirectories of {template-dir} for step definition JSON files with id fields
Also scan ~/.claude/agentic-processes/framework-steps/ subdirectories for framework step definitions with id fields
For each stepRef UUID: look up in the registry -- mark as valid if found, missing if not found
No name-based fallback -- UUID must resolve or it is marked as missing

substeps.name: Create validation report
actions: List all valid step references
List all missing step references
Calculate validation summary (X of Y valid)

substeps.name: List missing steps
substeps.description: Document missing steps with their UUIDs
actions: For each missing step UUID, document the UUID and the stepRefName (if available) for readability
Check if the step definition exists but has a different id -- this indicates a UUID mismatch
Instruct user to either create a step definition with the expected id or update the template's stepRef to the correct UUID

substeps.name: Handle missing steps
substeps.description: Report missing steps and stop if any are found
actions: If missing steps found: report the list and STOP -- user must create step subdirectories within the template
If all steps valid: proceed to next step
Document validation result in memory

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?

Log problems: If any problems, errors, workarounds, or unexpected situations were encountered during this step, log them via add-log-entry --problems '["description of problem 1", ...]'. This feeds the continuous-improvement step's analysis.
Output: 'Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Linear flow: read template -> extract stepRef values -> check existence -> create report -> list missing -> handle missing

fields: Information Produced: Validation results, missing steps list
Decisions Made: How to handle missing steps

referenceFormat.resolution: UUID-only lookup -- scan step definition JSON files for matching id field
referenceFormat.templateSteps: Scan {template-dir} subdirectories for {subfolder}/{subfolder}.json files with matching id
referenceFormat.frameworkSteps: Scan ~/.claude/agentic-processes/framework-steps/ subdirectories for step definitions with matching id
